name: A4F
short: Unified AI proxy and gateway providing access to hundreds of LLMs (300+ models across 50+ providers, per homepage) through an OpenAI-compatible API key with a free tier. Hosted third-party lineup spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, xAI Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen, Meta, Mistral, and Gemma families.

plans.name: Free Tier
plans.notes: Instant OpenAI-compatible API key upon sign-up ("no credit card required to begin!" - verbatim on homepage). Free plan: Limited AI Models, 5 RPM rate limit, 300 RPD request limit, limited context (~50%), unlimited validity. Free forever.

plans.name: Ultra
plans.notes: Exclusive access to Gemini 3, Claude, Grok, and GPT Codex plus every other model on the platform; 10 RPM base (add +5 RPM/month), unlimited requests, original context, 95% uptime guarantee, priority support. Introductory $40/month; increases to $45/month (announcement 2025-11-20; $40 lock-in still offered as of 2026-11-05). Yearly $336/year at intro rate ($378/year after increase).
